status: FROZEN once hashed. v1-v4 protocols and results unchanged. Any change here = v6. The GARCH audit gets its own protocol (v5b) frozen before it runs.
questions: A. Seed power: with 50 seeds at the 2-year span, is the QLSTMT-vs-LSTM/GRU gap on next-hour ln RV (2026 test) still positive (QLSTMT worse), null, or reversed? v3 used 5 seeds.
B. Rolling origin under stress: does the same comparison hold on the 4 highest-volatility calendar years, each with a 2-year training span?
data: hourly_ext_windows.csv; target ln realized variance of next hour; inputs last 10 bars x [ret, lrv1m, lvol, hod sin, hod cos]; models and training exactly as v3 (Adam lr 0.005, batch 32, max 25 epochs, patience 5, validation-only early stopping, every 5th block of 500 windows as validation, purge 10)

part_A_seeds.span: 2 years before 2026-01-01, test = 2026 (4,155 windows), identical to v3 S2
part_A_seeds.models: LSTM (hidden 5, 233-param matched), GRU (hidden 6), QLSTMT (4 qubits, 1 layer, hidden 16, 233 params)
part_A_seeds.seeds: 0-49 fresh under the v5 package versions; N = 50 FIXED in advance, all 50 reported, no stopping on results. If compute runs out the first 30 seeds (0-29) are reported and the cut is stated.
part_A_seeds.v3_check: v3 seeds 0-4 (older library versions) kept as a version-comparison check only, not pooled

part_B_rolling.origin_rule: the 4 calendar years with highest mean ln RV of the next-hour target among years with a full 2-year history (2012-2025): 2022 (-11.608), 2025 (-11.790), 2021 (-11.964), 2015 (-11.970). 2011 excluded (under 2 years of history). Next ranked: 2020 (-12.010).
part_B_rolling.selection_note: Origins are chosen by their own outcome volatility (selection on test-period characteristics), so the result is a STRESS test, not an unbiased average. Not claimed as typical performance.
part_B_rolling.train: the 2 calendar years before the test year, train/val rows purged 10 bars before the first test window
part_B_rolling.models: LSTM, GRU, QLSTMT as Part A

benchmarks: HAR + hour-of-day (OLS on the same training span); EWMA reported for reference
primary_outcome: seed-ensemble MSE ratio to HAR+hod; gap = QLSTMT ratio minus LSTM (and GRU) ratio
tests: Part A: DM (squared error, HAC lag 24) on seed-ensembles; plus Wilcoxon rank-sum on 50 per-seed ratios QLSTMT vs LSTM and vs GRU and bootstrap 95% CI of the mean per-seed ratio gap, Holm over the 2 comparisons. Part B: DM per origin, Holm across the 4 origins within each comparison; no pooled significance claim
environment_note: v5 runs use torch 2.15.0, pennylane 0.45.1, arch 8.0.0, numpy and pandas as installed in the scratch venv; v3 used older, unrecorded versions. Wall time per fit measured in a single-process timing run first (not scored).
